raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator misframed the task from the outset by listing “sample standard deviations” as facts to look up on ScienceDirect, instead of directing the team to retrieve the 2022 counts of Reference Works by subdomain for Life Sciences and Health Sciences and compute the sample standard deviations themselves. This led to misguided searches for “sample standard deviation” pages and methodology articles, rather than extracting the necessary counts from ScienceDirect/Elsevier materials and performing the calculation, causing the process to stall and ultimately fail.
